items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: I worked out there with Andrew Drippchen.

ctx.x: That's what Sam Morgan was bad. How about Andrew? Is he a good car player, Andrew Morgan? Well I don't think Andrew can play at all. He might blow it. I don't think he's fooling the car as much. But back then he might have, he got us, but then I said they missed with him.
Well now these fellas, Kaiser and Blind Charlie, did they play sax too or just clarinet?
